$comment: The villains' deck, written by hand for match setup (docs/evidence/match-setup.md section D) and kept reproducible here: node tools/build-deck.ts writes decks/doom-legion.dck from this list, byte for byte. decks/README.md is what it is and how it plays.
name: Doom Legion (Marvel Super Heroes villains)
archetype: tempo-control villains: cheap Villains that trade, removal, fliers and a drain engine

cards.name: Aerial Doombot
cards.why: 1-drop flying robot; power-up makes it a 4/4 flyer late

cards.name: Agents of HYDRA
cards.why: a 1/1 that leaves a 2/1 menace Villain token when it dies

cards.name: Loki, God of Mischief
cards.why: 2-drop that draws when one of your abilities targets

cards.name: Doom's Servo-Guards
cards.why: 2/2 artifact robot: gain 2, mill 2

cards.name: Doom Reigns Supreme
cards.why: the Plan: every Villain that enters drains 1; the fifth counter casts two of your top five free

cards.name: Dark Deed
cards.why: instant -4/-4 (the AI holds it: one cast in 38 games, match-setup section D.6)

cards.name: Doom Blade
cards.why: destroy a nonblack creature, and every creature Pacho plays is nonblack

cards.name: Baron Strucker, HYDRA Overlord
cards.why: Villain spells cost {1} less; another Villain entering may connive

cards.name: HYDRA Troopers
cards.why: 3/2 that makes a menace token or mills 2 to set one up

cards.name: A.I.M. Bot
cards.why: 2/3 flying artifact robot

cards.name: Visions of Villainy
cards.why: draw two, lose 2; cheaper with a Villain out

cards.name: Frozen in Ice
cards.why: removal aura that the AI puts on your best creature

cards.name: Kang the Conqueror
cards.why: 4/5 flyer whose power-up is an extra turn (never reached yet)

cards.name: Kang, Temporal Tyrant
cards.why: the gold card: connives on attack, drains on your second draw

cards.name: Unliving Legionnaire
cards.why: 3/2 flyer whose power-up returns a creature card

cards.name: Madame Hydra, Reanimated
cards.why: menace, grows with the creature cards in your graveyard

cards.name: Hour of Defeat
cards.why: destroy target creature, surveil 1

cards.name: Crossbones, Malicious Mercenary
cards.why: 3/3 deathtouch; each turn's first other Villain grows him and deals 2 to you (replaced Trickster's Stratagem, which the AI never cast)

cards.name: Pharaoh Rama-Tut
cards.why: 4/4 ward 2, a Kang; replaced Kang Prime, whose library reveal fails the redaction gate

cards.name: Doctor Doom
cards.why: brings two 3/3 Doombots, indestructible with an artifact creature or a Plan

cards.name: Thriving Isle
cards.why: blue, plus the colour the AI names

cards.name: Thriving Moor
cards.why: black, plus the colour the AI names

cards.name: Hidden Lair
cards.why: U/B while you control a basic

cards.name: Castle Doom
cards.why: any colour for artifact spells; a Doombot for {3} and an artifact

cards.name: Villainous Hideout
cards.why: any colour for a Villain; {3}, tap: a Villain connives

cards.name: Swamp
cards.why: black is the main colour (17 pips)

cards.name: Island
cards.why: blue the second (9 pips)
